notes: Every credited second rests on a track anchor, so all 387 s are level C and labeled via_track.
logged_s and ai_logged_s are 0: cli.track records never count (DESIGN 6.2 D19), and nothing else of the session reaches pairtime.

level_c_cap_s is min(level_c_s, ai_logged_s / 3), the most a program that opts in to level C could take inside forge-verified commit intervals (DESIGN 5.2, 6.2 D5; SM 5.4). It is 0, so the loop earns 0 submittable seconds whatever the program's policy, as DESIGN 5.2 requires.

The READ seconds, the X.no_anchor seconds after 14:06:09 and agent_running_s from 14:04 on, its total included, depend on the erratum: a track turn has no agent record, so the rules don't say whether it is running. Read literally, the turn the 14:04:00 call opens would run to the end of the window, making them SUP, X.agent_only and 300 s, and 14:08 would get a bucket.
